details:
Farmo is a free, multilingual web app designed to empower smallholder farmers with AI tools to prevent crop loss. It features voice assistance in local languages, AI disease diagnosis from photos, an irrigation planner, and a climate simulator using NASA satellite data to predict yields.
Built with React, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, and Deno, it makes precision agriculture accessible and free, aiming to improve food security and farmer income without requiring accounts or technical expertise.
Key aspects include low-literacy usability with voice commands, offline resilience, cultural relevance aligned with regional agriculture, and zero-cost access to ensure tools reach over 500 million smallholder farmers worldwide.
